queryLines:
-- Example: correlation matrix for 5 features
WITH features AS (
  SELECT
    corr(account_balance, transaction_amount) AS corr_ab_ta,
    corr(account_balance, transaction_hour)   AS corr_ab_th,
    corr(account_balance, credit_score)       AS corr_ab_cs,
    corr(account_balance, emi_amount)         AS corr_ab_emi,
    corr(transaction_amount, transaction_hour) AS corr_ta_th,
    corr(transaction_amount, credit_score)     AS corr_ta_cs,
    corr(transaction_amount, emi_amount)       AS corr_ta_emi,
    corr(transaction_hour, credit_score)       AS corr_th_cs,
    corr(transaction_hour, emi_amount)         AS corr_th_emi,
    corr(credit_score, emi_amount)             AS corr_cs_emi
  FROM brz_bank_transactions
  WHERE account_balance IS NOT NULL
    AND transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND transaction_hour IS NOT NULL
    AND credit_score IS NOT NULL
    AND emi_amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM features;
